user.title: Energy Price Graph
user.description: Adds a dynamic electricity price graph to the built-in Energy dashboard. The price sensors are read from your energy settings (Electricity grid → costs / compensation). You can change the options afterwards via Configure. Refresh your browser after setup.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Energy Price Graph is already set up.

init.title: Energy Price Graph options
init.description: After saving, refresh your browser (Ctrl+F5) to see the changes.

data_description.period: Auto follows the selected date range. 5-minute data is only kept as long as your recorder keeps history (purge_keep_days).
data_description.line_style: Stepped shows the exact price per period (recommended for dynamic prices). Straight connects the points directly. Smooth draws a rounded curve.
data_description.views: Tabs of the Energy dashboard where the graph is shown.
data_description.show_export: Adds a second line when the export price is a different sensor than the import price.
data_description.minmax: Also draws the lowest and highest price within each period.
data_description.title: Leave empty for the default title.
data_description.import_entity: Leave empty to use the sensor from your energy settings.
data_description.export_entity: Leave empty to use the sensor from your energy settings.
